content.title: Luke Combs’ 2026 Jack Trice Stadium Show in Ames, Iowa: Everything You Need to Know | Holler
content.text: LUKE COMBS 2026 ‘MY KINDA SATURDAY NIGHT’ TOUR - AMES, IOWAWhen: Saturday, April 11th, 2026Where: Jack Trice StadiumWho are the Openers: Dierks Bentley, Ty Myers, Jake Worthington and Thelma & JamesWhat is Luke Combs Expected to Perform: Taken from Luke Combs’ set at Scott Stadium in Charlottesville, Virginia on April 4th, 2026My Kinda Saturday NightLovin‘ On YouHurricaneShe Got the Best Of MeTell ‘Em About TonightOne Number AwaySoon As I Get HomeBack in the SaddleMust've Never Met YouThe Kind Of Love We MakeSleepless in a Hotel RoomRethink Some ThingsForever After AllBetter TogetherI Ain't No CowboyWish Upon a WhiskeyRemember Him That WayBe By YouBeautiful CrazyCrazy Train / She Will Be Loved / Billie Jean / I Don't Wanna Miss a Thing / Something Like ThatAlcohol of FameCold As YouWhen It Rains It Pours1, 2 ManyBeer Never Broke My HeartEncoreFast Car (Tracy Chapman cover)Where the Wild Things AreAin't No Love in OklahomaWhen Do Doors Open: 5pmWhen Does the First Opener Perform: 5:20pmWhat Time Does Luke Take the Stage: Usually around 9pmWhere Can I Buy Tickets: Luke Combs 2026 Tickets Luke Combs continues his huge 2026 My Kinda Saturday Night World Tour with an keenly awaited show at Ames’ Jack Trice Stadium. Combs is due to headline the colossal Iowa venue - which can welcome around 61,500 fans - on Saturday, April 11th.The North Carolina native is bringing with him a star-studded array of openers, with Combs’ 2026 shows feeling more like mini-festivals than standard country concerts. Combs is supported by Dierks Bentley, Ty Myers, Jake Worthington and Thelma & James. Doors open at 5pm, with the first act - Thelma & James - expected to take the stage shortly after at 5:20pm. Combs tends to start his set at around 9pm, finishing at roughly 11pm - but as always, all of the evening's set times are subject to change. There's a strict bag policy in place, which you can check out in full HERE. As for merchandise, judging by Combs’ 2026 tour-stops so far, there is an excitingly broad range of new tees, hoodies, koozies, caps and more all themed around Combs’ new album, The Way I Am, and his accompanying My Kinda Saturday Night Tour. There's a fun black t-shirt, for instance, emblazoned with the name of the tour on the front in a neon-bar-sign-inspired design, and all the dates on the back. There's also a camo tee with Combs’ signature skull-and-beard logo, along with a handful of other tour t-shirt options. In addition to a plethora of caps and hoodies, it looks like the ‘Beautiful Crazy’ hitmaker is selling his now-iconic Columbia PFG performance shirt for $75, which Combs famously wears for every single live show. Merchandise will be available at Jack Trice Stadium at the locations below:Albaugh Plaza (north side)Reiman Plaza (south side)Gate 2 at ground level (east side - outside the stadium)Inside the stadium on the NW, NE, SW and SE cornersSimilarly, Combs’ 2026 setlist is overflowing with hits. Thankfully, he's so far been keeping all his biggest heaters in there, such as ’Beer Never Broke My Heart’, ‘Fast Car’, ‘Beautiful Crazy’, ‘She Got the Best Of Me’, ‘When It Rains It Pours’, ‘Hurricane’, ‘Lovin’ On You’, ‘Ain't No Love in Oklahoma’ and ’Where the Wild Things Are’. Another song we can say with almost certainty - although you never know - that Combs will perform is his rowdy earworm, ‘My Kinda Saturday Night’, as it inspired the tour's name. Throughout 2026, Combs appears to be kicking off his set with this smash. We hope he mixes things up in terms of which of the new songs he performs throughout the tour, but based off his 2026 setlist so far, you can look forward to hearing The Way I Am stand-outs such as ‘Rethink Some Things’, ‘Tell ‘Em About Tonight’, ‘Sleepless in a Hotel Room’, ‘Be By You’, ‘I Ain't No Cowboy’ and ‘Back in the Saddle’. From time to time, Combs has also been covering Alex Warren's hit single, ’Ordinary’, which the duo teamed up to perform at Lollapalooza in Chicago last summer. At his previous date in Virginia, Combs replaced ‘Ordinary’ with ‘Alcohol of Fame’, one of our favourites from The Way I Am, as well as adding in ‘Soon As I Get Home’. There are a range of parking options if you're planning to drive to Jack Trice Stadium, and you can purchase your stadium parking pass HERE - but at the time of writing, there are only RV spots available. Please bear in mind that all parking passes will be issued electronically. Before you enter, make sure to download your pass. There will be a handful of parking options on offer to purchase on the day for $40 at B1, C1, C2 (north of Center Drive near Hilton Coliseum), grass lots along South 16th Street. Excitingly, Combs has been switching up his staging a little in 2026, with the two-time CMA Entertainer of the Year performing ‘in the round’ from a circular stage at the heart of the floor, ensuring attendees can get a good viewpoint wherever they're sat. One thing is for sure - Combs will put on an electrifying show, with the country titan renowned for his varied, high-energy sets that combine his penchant for soulful, heartfelt ballads with his ability to deliver a soaring, galvanising barroom soundtrack.
